column1: Built from the Full Body Starter program as Badger 1.1.15 exports it. The sets, reps and rules are the app's, and weights are worked out the way the app works them out.
Run this program in Badger: https://badger.fit/programs/
Alternate Day A and Day B, three times a week. When a set feels easy at the top of its reps, add a little weight next time.
Write the weight you used for each exercise in the week columns. Use the same unit all the way down.
